data.name: Arkam
data.gender_notes: Arkam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A strong, powerful, and intelligent name. Derived from the Arabic word 'arkama', meaning 'to strengthen'. The name Arkam carries the meaning “Strong, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Arkam usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner strength and resilience, inspiring confidence and courage.
data.etymology: Arkam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arkam total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: أركم
in_arabic.long_meaning: أركم هو اسم عربي يعود إلى الجذور العربية القديمة، مشتق من كلمة أركم التي تعني GENEROUS و الكريم، وهو مصطلح يشير إلى الشخص السخي و المعتدل، و له أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية و التاريخية

in_urdu.name: اركم
in_urdu.long_meaning: اركم ایک عربی نام ہے جو قدیم عرب کی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، یہ نام اركم سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوش ذات اور سخی، یہ اسلامی ثقافت اور تاریخ میں بہت اہمیت کا حامل ہے

in_hindi.name: अर्कम

in_pashto.name: اركم
